question: Do maintainers approve this broad removal of file-era active transcript runtime, including the new Plugin SDK sessionTarget surface and the remaining deprecated sessionFile compatibility boundary?
rationale: The branch changes a persisted runtime ownership model and a public plugin-facing contract across many subsystems; automated review cannot decide the intended long-term external compatibility and deprecation policy.

options.title: Approve after boundary proof
options.body: Require redacted live SQLite, doctor-import, and trajectory-export proof plus green exact-head checks, then confirm the retained sessionFile deprecation contract.

options.title: Keep file compatibility longer
options.body: Retain a deliberately documented compatibility adapter for external sessionFile consumers if maintainers judge the current Plugin SDK transition window too narrow.

options.title: Split the refactor
options.body: Pause this branch and split the public Plugin SDK transition from internal JSONL runtime deletion if review cannot establish one safe compatibility boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve after boundary proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted live SQLite, doctor-import, and trajectory-export proof plus green exact-head checks, then confirm the retained sessionFile deprecation contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch history shows this contributor owns the proposed implementation and its compatibility decisions pending maintainer confirmation.
